statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-71328 (GHSA-63gh-g2x5-x69v) is an out-of-bounds write in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native, the native Windows library that .NET tools use to read and write PDB symbol files, when it processes MSFZ PDB files. Microsoft lists Windows as the only affected platform and, for .NET 10, the Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native NuGet package from 17.12.0-beta1.24603.5 through 18.9.0-beta1.26405.1 as affected, fixed in 18.9.0-beta1.26405.2 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-63gh-g2x5-x69v, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/440). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every PE file in them is a managed .NET assembly with a CLR header, and none is a native Windows executable or DLL. Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native ships only as native Windows DLLs, so it is not present in any published build.

CVE-2026-71328 (GHSA-63gh-g2x5-x69v) is an out-of-bounds write in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native, the native Windows library that .NET tools use to read and write PDB symbol files, when it processes MSFZ PDB files. Microsoft lists Windows as the only affected platform and, for .NET 8, the Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native NuGet package from 17.12.0-beta1.24603.5 through 18.9.0-beta1.26405.1 as affected, fixed in 18.9.0-beta1.26405.2 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-63gh-g2x5-x69v, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/440, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.31/8.0.31.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: no file in them is a Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native library, and every PE file in them is a managed .NET assembly with a CLR header, none a native Windows executable or DLL. The managed Microsoft.DiaSymReader.dll interop library, carried by the dotnet-format and dotnet watch tools and by Microsoft.DiaSymReader nupkg files, is a different package and is a managed assembly with no native code. Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native ships only as native Windows DLLs, so it is not present in any published build.

CVE-2026-71328 (GHSA-63gh-g2x5-x69v) is a remote code execution issue in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native: an out-of-bounds write can occur while processing MSFZ PDB files. Microsoft lists Windows as the only affected platform and the Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native NuGet package (17.10.0-beta1.24272.1 through 18.9.0-beta1.26405.1, fixed in 18.9.0-beta1.26405.2) as the only affected package (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-63gh-g2x5-x69v, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/440, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.20/9.0.20.md). Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native consists of native Windows DLLs. DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. None of them contains a Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native file or nupkg, and none contains a native Windows PE file; every PE file in them is a managed .NET assembly. The managed Microsoft.DiaSymReader library (version 2.2.0-beta.24327.2) is present in the dotnet-format and dotnet-watch tools of the SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and as Microsoft.DiaSymReader nupkg files in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts; it is a separate package that Microsoft does not list as affected. So the vulnerable native component is not in this owner.
